name: v40_pension_funded_status_quality
hypothesis: Better defined-benefit plan funded status and lower noncurrent pension/postretirement liabilities can identify firms with fewer hidden benefit obligations, a route distinct from ordinary debt or cashflow quality.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank((defined_benefit_plan_asset_fair_value - defined_benefit_plan_obligation_value) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * noncurrent_pension_postretirement_liabilities / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * net_periodic_cost_defined_benefit_plan / assets, 126), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_60_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Uses low-alphaCount pension fields; no close/open, EPS, graph, option, sales, cashflow, or deferred revenue.

name: v40_pension_contribution_obligation_relief
hypothesis: Employer pension contributions are more favorable when future benefit payments and pension OCI noise are low, suggesting manageable benefit obligations.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(pension_employer_contributions / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * future_benefit_payments_next_12mo / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(oci_pension_postretirement_net_tax) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Pension cash commitment and OCI noise; watch coverage and LOW_SUB_UNIVERSE_SHARPE.

name: v40_oci_fx_hedge_stability
hypothesis: Lower FX translation and hedge OCI volatility may identify cleaner balance sheets less exposed to hidden currency and hedge mark-to-market noise.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(fx_translation_oci_net_tax) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(hedge_derivative_oci_net_tax) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(cumulative_oci_cash_flow_hedge_net) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_60_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry)
notes: A more specific OCI variant than v21 accumulated-OCI stability; no lease/graph stabilizer.

name: v40_available_for_sale_oci_clean
hypothesis: Low available-for-sale securities OCI adjustments and low broad OCI burden may proxy cleaner mark-to-market risk in financial and asset-heavy firms.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(available_for_sale_securities_oci_adjustment) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(available_for_sale_securities_value_2) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(accumulated_oci_net_of_tax_value) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_60_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: More specific AFS-securities OCI probe; compare against v21 OCI weak result.

name: v40_level3_fair_value_opacity
hypothesis: Lower level-3 fair-value assets and liabilities should proxy less valuation opacity and model-risk exposure, distinct from conventional leverage.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * recurring_assets_fair_value_lvl3 / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * recurring_liabilities_fair_value_level3 / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank((recurring_assets_fair_value_lvl2 - recurring_assets_fair_value_lvl3) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (unsystematic_risk_last_60_days - unsystematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry)
notes: Fair-value hierarchy opacity; underused but possibly sector-sensitive.

name: v40_derivative_net_asset_cleanliness
hypothesis: Positive derivative asset versus liability balance with low notional exposure may indicate cleaner hedge book exposure than the v34 derivative-liability-only attempt.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank((derivative_asset_fair_value - derivative_liability_fair_value) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * derivative_contract_notional_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(hedge_derivative_oci_net_tax) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Revisits derivative fair-value as net exposure without event sentiment; v34 liability-only was weak.

name: v40_stock_option_overhang_clean
hypothesis: Lower outstanding/granted stock-option overhang and fewer shares issued from option exercises may reduce future dilution without relying on crowded buyback/share-count contraction signals.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * option_award_outstanding_count / common_shares_outstanding_total, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * option_awards_granted_count / common_shares_outstanding_total, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * shares_issued_stock_options_exercised / common_shares_outstanding_total, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_60_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Corrects v34 share-option-overhang field availability and avoids common-stock buyback or close/open.

name: v40_rsu_unrecognized_comp_burden
hypothesis: Low unrecognized option and non-option compensation cost with low RSU expense may identify lower future stock-comp dilution and cleaner earnings.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unrecognized_compensation_cost_nonvested_stock_options / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unrecognized_comp_cost_nonoption_awards / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * allocated_sbp_expense_rsu / sales, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (unsystematic_risk_last_60_days - unsystematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry)
notes: Stock-comp burden without allocated_sbp_expense_total or buyback; watch relation to stock-comp/goodwill failures.
